caption_editorial: The Heritage at Pine Woods. Charcoal brick, an arched entry glowing at dusk, and 3,143 sq ft finished and ready for you today. Rochester Hills, Lot 7. Comment {{KEYWORD}} for details.
caption_lifestyle: Groceries land on the mud room bench, coats find their hooks, and the kitchen fills up before dinner's even plated. The Heritage in Pine Woods is ready for your first evening in it.
caption_feature: 4 bed · 3 bath · 3,143 sq ft · 3-car. Open kitchen + walk-in pantry, library, mud room drop zone, primary suite w/ spa bath. Move-in ready at Pine Woods. DM TOUR
first_comment_hook: That walk-in pantry sits steps from the island and double wall ovens. Would you fill it with baking gear, small appliances, or a wine stash first? Tell us below 👇
alt_text: Photo 1: Two-story colonial with dark charcoal brick, limestone-style accents, steep gables, and an arched entry portico, photographed at twilight with warm light glowing from the windows, coach lights beside a double and single garage door, and a wide concrete driveway. Photo 2: Kitchen with dark-stained shaker cabinets, white quartz counters, white subway tile backsplash, stainless chimney hood over a gas cooktop, double wall ovens, French-door refrigerator, large island with a cheese board and glasses, a three-globe pendant, wide-plank oak floors, and an open walk-in pantry with woven baskets. Photo 3: Family room with a corner fireplace in dark veined stone and a wood mantel, charcoal sofa, three leather armchairs around a brass drum coffee table, linen drapes, black-and-white coastal art, and a ceiling fan. Photo 4: Primary bedroom with a stepped tray ceiling, tufted charcoal upholstered bed with a chunky knit throw, gold-framed mirror, brass lamps on dark nightstands, a matching dresser, fiddle leaf fig trees, and plush neutral carpet. Photo 5: Mud room with built-in white beadboard lockers, coat hooks holding jackets and a leather backpack, a bench with folded blankets, cubbies with boots and mail, a window, a double-door closet, and a hallway door over wood-look flooring.

reel_script.0-2s: Blue-hour exterior: slow push-in on the glowing arched entry and charcoal brick facade. On-screen text: 'Move-in ready. Pine Woods.'
reel_script.2-5s: Garage-to-mud room POV: walk past the beadboard lockers, hooks, and drop-zone bench. Text: 'Drop zone, sorted.'
reel_script.5-8s: Glide through the kitchen from sink to island, then reveal the walk-in pantry and the open family room fireplace. Text: 'Kitchen, pantry, great room. One flow.'
reel_script.8-10s: Primary suite: tilt up to the stepped ceiling, then quick cut to the soaking tub and oversized shower. Text: 'Your spa, upstairs.'
reel_script.10-12s: Back to twilight exterior, wide shot. Text: 'The Heritage · 3110 Raffler Dr · 4 bed / 3 bath / 3,143 sq ft. DM TOUR'
